subject: KPI heatmap & QBR asks — priority owners and artifacts
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KPI heatmap & QBR asks — priority owners and artifacts

Team — attaching the August KPI heatmap and a one-pager playbook for QBR prep (attachments below). I pulled the dashboard snapshots this morning; top-line observations we need to own for the QBR: 

- Latency: p95 inference increased ~18% week-over-week in eu-west during peak hours (11:00–14:00 UTC). Root cause unclear — could be batching changes or a backend kernel fallback.
- Cost: unit token cost up ~12% M/M; observed larger spend from a handful of dedicated pools during bursts. Need an actionable cost-save target for the exec ask.
- Uptime: service availability steady at 99.95% but two short degradations (5–7 mins) tied to autoscaler thrash on 7/28.
- Usage: customer footprint up ~34% M/M; top account contributing to peak is AtlasCloud (see usage CSV).

Asks (please confirm owners by EOD Monday):
1) Deep-dive for latency regression (2 slides): timeline, suspected root cause(s), short-term mitigation, owner + on-call contacts — owner: ?
2) Cost playbook (2 slides): concrete $/token reduction levers and expected delta (quantization, batch config, per-route routing) — owner: ?
3) Uptime incident summary (1 slide): sequence of events, fix applied, follow-up actions.
4) Customer usage note (1 slide): AtlasCloud callouts + recommended pre-QBR outreach.

Attachments: KPI_heatmap_aug.xlsx, service_vitals_snapshot.pdf, qbr-prep-playbook.md (link below).

Proposed schedule: internal pre-read by 8/10, dry-run on 8/14, exec QBR week of 8/21. If you need longer lead time call it out.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Inference Ops
Redwood Inference

Quick context: the runtime team shipped a scheduler tweak on 7/25 to improve throughput for long-context chat. Early telemetry showed improved avg tokens/sec but we started to see p95 jitter under high-concurrency bursts. I'll pull kernel selection logs, batching histograms, and KV cache hit rates for the timeframe (11:00–14:00 UTC).

I'll own the 2-slide packet and coordinate with Runtime SRE (cc'ing via separate thread). Target: draft slides by 8/9.

—Lauren
